source: General theory for packing icosahedral shells into multi-component aggregates

hexagonal_coordinate_mapping.definition: Shell positions mapped to hexagonal lattice coordinates (h,k) with sequence paths
assumptions: Hexagonal lattice provides complete coverage of icosahedral surface
Coordinate sequence defines permissible growth paths
Each (h,k) position corresponds to unique shell addition site
invariants: h >= 0, k >= 0 for all valid positions
Sequence must be contiguous (no skipped positions)
hexagonal_coordinate_mapping.verification: hexagonal_coords list contains 36 valid (h,k) pairs starting from (0,0)

magic_number_sequences.definition: Discrete atom counts for stable icosahedral shells
assumptions: New b=5 sequence: alternative chiral variant with reduced intermediate counts
Both sequences share core (N=1) and first shell (N=13)

chiral_category_classification.definition: Seven structural classes: MC, BG, Ch1-Ch5
assumptions: Ch1-Ch5: chiral variants with decreasing symmetry
Each category has distinct optimal mismatch range
invariants: Energy hierarchy: MC < Ch1 < BG for same shell number

size_mismatch_optimization.definition: δ = |r₂ - r₁| / max(r₁, r₂) compared against category-specific optimal ranges
assumptions: Atomic radii are fixed physical constants
Optimal ranges derived from energy minimization
Structures within range are thermodynamically stable
invariants: Lower δ required for homo-chiral stacking
Higher δ tolerated for hetero-chiral transitions
size_mismatch_optimization.verification: calculate_size_mismatch function and validate_cluster_predictions working correctly

dynamic_growth_simulation.definition: Stochastic assembly with conservative, mismatch-driven, and random pathways
invariants: Growth results show monotonic mismatch evolution per trajectory
dynamic_growth_simulation.verification: path_probability_weights and growth_results match source data

deviations_from_source.justification: All analyses directly reproduce parameters and methods from source reproduction data without modification
